# .github/

CI 与发布工作流：`ci.yml`（六平台测试、竞态、交叉编译、移动端构建）、
`release.yml`（发布矩阵、发布页核验）、`mobile-app.yml`（gomobile AAR 与
Android App 的 debug APK）。

The CI and release workflows: `ci.yml` (six platforms, race, cross-compile,
mobile builds), `release.yml` (the release matrix and its verification) and
`mobile-app.yml` (the gomobile AAR and the Android app's debug APK).
